name: mintAgeMs
definition: decision_receive_ms - create_receive_ms; fixed rows use the checkpoint age and FIRST_IMPULSE_EVENT uses first_buy_receive_ms - create_receive_ms.
rationale: Controls the amount of causal tape available and prevents unlike decision ages from being conflated.
evidence_relation: Measurement/control variable, not standalone causal alpha.
leakage_risk: low if receive clock is monotonic
selection_bias_risk: high because V1 emits no row before any trade event
notes: Frozen V1 scanner explicitly excludes this numeric field; always retain it as conditioning metadata.

name: buyCount
definition: Count of decoded buy TradeEvents with arrival_ms <= decision_ms.
rationale: Measures cumulative demand-event intensity.
evidence_relation: Empirical association and curve-path mechanism; count can be wash-manufactured.
leakage_risk: low when event cutoff is receive-time strict
notes: Scanned generically at every observation state.

name: sellCount
definition: Count of decoded sell TradeEvents with arrival_ms <= decision_ms.
rationale: Captures immediate supply and reversal pressure.
evidence_relation: Mechanistic flow measure with empirical support at later horizons.
notes: FIRST_IMPULSE_EVENT is necessarily buy-led but can share a receive timestamp with other events; order semantics need explicit tie handling in V2.

name: buyCount25ms
definition: At decision d, count buys with arrival_ms > d-25 and <= d.
rationale: Measures the shortest V1 demand burst.
evidence_relation: Plausible association; exact 25 ms horizon is not externally validated.
data_quality_risk: provider batching dominates at this scale
notes: Left-open, right-closed receive-time window.

name: buyCount50ms
definition: At decision d, count buys with arrival_ms > d-50 and <= d.
rationale: Measures very-short demand burst while reducing 25 ms batching sensitivity.
notes: Left-open, right-closed receive-time window.

name: buyCount100ms
definition: At decision d, count buys with arrival_ms > d-100 and <= d.
rationale: Core fast-impulse count used by a frozen descriptive rule.
evidence_relation: Empirical candidate in V1; no future outcomes were inspected here.
notes: Used by FAST100 and FIRST_IMPULSE_FAST100 descriptions; no thresholds were retuned.

name: buyCount250ms
definition: At decision d, count buys with arrival_ms > d-250 and <= d.
rationale: Short-horizon demand intensity.
notes: All windows are relative to each decision, not launch-relative buckets.

name: buyCount500ms
definition: At decision d, count buys with arrival_ms > d-500 and <= d.
rationale: Balances burst and persistence.
evidence_relation: Association; rapid curve progression has related empirical support.
notes: Count-only; SOL flow speed is absent.

name: buyCount1000ms
definition: At decision d, count buys with arrival_ms > d-1000 and <= d.
rationale: One-second demand persistence.
notes: Does not count unique buyers.

name: sellCount100ms
definition: At decision d, count sells with arrival_ms > d-100 and <= d.
rationale: Detects immediate reversal events.
notes: Count ignores sell size.

name: sellCount500ms
definition: At decision d, count sells with arrival_ms > d-500 and <= d.
rationale: Short-horizon supply pressure count.
notes: Use jointly with value and seller identity.

name: sellCount1000ms
definition: At decision d, count sells with arrival_ms > d-1000 and <= d.
rationale: One-second reversal persistence.
notes: Use jointly with value and seller identity.

name: uniqueBuyers
definition: Number of distinct TradeEvent.user values among buys observed by decision.
rationale: Separates broad participation from repeated prints by one wallet.
evidence_relation: Strong empirical association; identity independence is not guaranteed.
data_quality_risk: user is wallet, not beneficial entity
notes: Entity-adjusted unique demand is a major missing extension.

name: uniqueSellers
definition: Number of distinct TradeEvent.user values among sells observed by decision.
rationale: Measures breadth of exit pressure.
notes: At the earliest checkpoints the value is structurally zero for most launches.

name: grossBuySol
definition: Sum immediate_quote_amount for buys divided by 1e9; V1 immediate buy quote includes SOL amount plus protocol fee, creator fee, and cashback.
rationale: Measures gross committed quote flow under frozen economic semantics.
evidence_relation: Direct economic state driver; predictive direction can be nonlinear.
notes: Do not silently substitute reserve delta or pre-fee SOL; V1 economic semantics are frozen.

name: grossSellSol
definition: Sum immediate_quote_amount for sells divided by 1e9; V1 immediate sell quote is SOL proceeds net of protocol and creator fees.
rationale: Measures realized exit quote flow.
notes: Frozen definition is cash received rather than invariant reserve movement.

name: netBuySol
definition: grossBuySol - grossSellSol using V1 immediate-quote definitions.
rationale: Compact directional quote-flow imbalance.
evidence_relation: Mechanistic association with curve progress, though fees make it differ from reserve delta.
notes: Used by OLD_RANKER_COMPONENT_PROXY at 1000 ms; this research did not retune it.

name: buyVelocity100
definition: buyCount100ms * 10, an extrapolated buys-per-second rate.
rationale: Normalizes a 100 ms event count to an intuitive rate.
evidence_relation: Algebraic transform of buyCount100ms, not independent evidence.
notes: Perfectly redundant with buyCount100ms; retain only for V1 compatibility.

name: buyVelocity500
definition: buyCount500ms * 2, an extrapolated buys-per-second rate.
rationale: Expresses half-second count as a rate.
notes: Perfectly redundant with buyCount500ms; retain only for V1 compatibility.

name: buyAcceleration100
definition: Buys with d-100 < arrival <= d minus buys with d-200 < arrival <= d-100.
rationale: Tests whether very-short event intensity is rising or fading.
evidence_relation: Plausible association; exact definition lacks independent validation.
notes: At checkpoints below 200 ms the older bucket is partly pre-launch and structurally empty.

name: sellPressure
definition: gross_sell_lamports / max(gross_buy_lamports,1).
rationale: Scale-free exit pressure.
notes: The denominator floor is one lamport in code; display-unit scaling cancels.

name: firstBuyerShareBps
definition: The first buy TradeEvent immediate quote amount divided by cumulative gross buy immediate quote, multiplied by 10,000.
rationale: Distinguishes first-print dominance from distributed follow-through.
evidence_relation: Mechanistically plausible and indirectly supported; no direct causal proof for exact 0-25 ms scalp alpha.
selection_bias_risk: high at first impulse where it is structurally 10000 unless same-time buys precede cutoff
notes: This is first transaction share, not cumulative share of the first distinct buyer. Thresholds including N3000 were not retuned.

name: topBuyerShareBps
definition: Maximum cumulative gross-buy immediate quote by user divided by total gross buy, multiplied by 10,000.
rationale: Measures wallet-level demand concentration.
evidence_relation: Large-sample risk association, but wallet splitting weakens interpretation.
notes: Duplicate information with dominance after unit scaling.

name: buyerHhi
definition: Sum over buyer wallets of squared cumulative gross-buy quote share.
rationale: Uses the full wallet-share distribution rather than only the maximum.
evidence_relation: Concentration is empirically associated with manipulation risk; entity grouping improves it.
notes: Entity-adjusted HHI is a P0 missing feature.

name: recurrentWalletShareBps
definition: Share of current gross buy quote from buyer wallets whose earliest prior observed appearance was on another mint with observed_ms < decision_ms.
rationale: Tests whether known cross-launch actors dominate early flow.
evidence_relation: Ex-ante history has empirical value, but recurrence alone mixes skilled and adversarial actors.
required_raw_data: causally frozen prior Pump observation index
cache_requirements: earliest prior wallet observation by mint
leakage_risk: high if prior index is rebuilt without as-of cutoffs
data_quality_risk: earliest-only index discards frequency, recency, and performance
notes: A thin history proxy, not a wallet-quality feature.

name: transactionDensity
definition: Number of distinct transaction signatures among observed buys and sells.
rationale: Separates multiple transactions from multiple decoded events in one transaction.
notes: It is a count, not a time-normalized density.

name: sameSlotBuyCount
definition: Count of buys whose slot equals the create event slot.
rationale: Captures same-slot launch participation.
evidence_relation: Practitioner association; same slot is not same transaction or bundle.
notes: Must not be described as same-transaction sniping.

name: failedTransactionCount
definition: Cumulative count through decision of failed Pump transactions attributed to the mint by the ledger's failed-observation index.
rationale: May reflect contention, bot attempts, bad routing, or decode/targeting noise.
evidence_relation: Ambiguous association; failure can accompany both strong demand and toxic automation.
selection_bias_risk: high because attribution requires mint discovery
data_quality_risk: target discovery misses failures without decodable mint evidence
notes: Normalize by successful attempts and network failure regime before treating as alpha.

name: earlyReserveMovementPct
definition: 100 * (latest observed virtual_sol_reserves - first event pre-state virtual_sol_reserves) / first event pre-state virtual_sol_reserves.
rationale: Directly tracks curve-state displacement from the first observed pre-state.
evidence_relation: Direct platform mechanism and empirically useful state path.
spoofability: medium; moving the curve costs quote and fees
notes: Base is first observed trade pre-state, not necessarily canonical launch initial state.

name: marketCapSol
definition: latest virtual_sol_reserves * supply_snapshot / latest virtual_token_reserves / 1e9 when a supply snapshot observed by the decision is available.
rationale: Approximate spot market capitalization on the virtual curve.
evidence_relation: Mechanically related to curve price; predictive thresholds are empirical.
leakage_risk: high if a later RPC supply snapshot is backfilled
notes: Only nullable V1 feature; immediate Tier A availability is not established by current retrospective implementation.

name: marketCapAvailable
definition: Integer indicator that a supply snapshot with observed_ms <= decision_ms exists.
rationale: Exposes informative missingness instead of silently imputing marketCapSol.
evidence_relation: Causal data-availability control, not economic alpha.
leakage_risk: high if snapshot time is not honored
selection_bias_risk: high; availability may correlate with provider/load
notes: Scanner treats this indicator as a candidate feature; V2 should primarily use it for missingness/quality gating.

name: dominance
definition: Maximum cumulative buyer-wallet gross quote divided by total gross buy quote.
rationale: Wallet concentration in unit interval.
notes: Exact scaled duplicate of topBuyerShareBps; exclude one from V2 model fitting to avoid redundant search degrees of freedom.

name: globalTrades1sPrior
definition: Count of all indexed Pump trade arrivals t satisfying decision_ms-1000 <= t < decision_ms.
rationale: Conditions a token impulse on immediate platform activity.
notes: Count only; no value, unique-wallet, or cross-sectional normalization.

name: globalTrades5sPrior
definition: Count of all indexed Pump trade arrivals t satisfying decision_ms-5000 <= t < decision_ms.
rationale: Short platform-activity regime.
notes: Use as denominator/context, not only a free-standing threshold.

name: globalTrades60sPrior
definition: Count of all indexed Pump trade arrivals t satisfying decision_ms-60000 <= t < decision_ms.
rationale: One-minute platform demand regime.
notes: A raw count; normalized local percentile is missing.

name: globalLaunches60sPrior
definition: Count of all indexed create arrivals t satisfying decision_ms-60000 <= t < decision_ms.
rationale: Measures launch supply and attention competition.
notes: Does not distinguish launches that attracted any trade.

name: grossBuySol100ms
definition: Sum V1-exact buy immediate quote over d-100 < arrival <= d.
rationale: Separates monetary impulse speed from event-count speed.
evidence_relation: Direct curve-driving flow with strong related state-path evidence.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate.

name: grossBuySol500ms
definition: Sum V1-exact buy immediate quote over d-500 < arrival <= d.
rationale: Tests sustained monetary demand rather than print count.
notes: Pair with unique-buyer growth.

name: netBuySol100ms
definition: V1-exact buy immediate quote minus sell immediate quote within the trailing 100 ms.
rationale: A local signed-flow derivative can distinguish a current impulse from stale cumulative net flow.
notes: Do not replace the cumulative frozen feature.

name: netFlowAcceleration100
definition: Trailing-100-ms net quote flow minus the preceding 100-ms net quote flow.
rationale: Measures acceleration in economically weighted demand.
evidence_relation: Mechanistic but exact predictive value unvalidated.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; value-weighted complement to count acceleration.

name: uniqueBuyers100ms
definition: Distinct buy users with d-100 < arrival <= d.
rationale: Tests whether a burst reflects independent wallet arrivals rather than repeated fills.
evidence_relation: Participation breadth is empirically useful; wallet independence remains a proxy.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate.

name: uniqueBuyerAcceleration100
definition: Distinct buyers in trailing 100 ms minus distinct buyers in the preceding 100 ms.
rationale: Measures growth or exhaustion of participation breadth.
compute_cost: O(events in 200 ms) or incremental counted maps
notes: More informative than total count when paired with entity clustering.

name: buysPerUniqueBuyer
definition: buyCount / max(uniqueBuyers,1).
rationale: Detects repeated-print intensity by the same wallets.
notes: Use minimum-count guard.

name: repeatBuyEventShare
definition: Fraction of buy events whose user has already bought this mint before that event.
rationale: Distinguishes organic wallet arrival from repeated bot slicing.
evidence_relation: Association; repeat participation can also be legitimate scaling.
notes: Interpret jointly with transaction route and entity graph.

name: meanBuySizeSol
definition: Cumulative V1-exact gross buy quote divided by buyCount.
rationale: Large average prints with few participants can indicate fragile concentration.
evidence_relation: Large-sample association with high-risk launches at later horizons.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate.

name: medianBuySizeSol
definition: Median V1-exact immediate quote of observed buys.
rationale: Robust center resistant to a single whale print.
compute_cost: O(n log n) snapshot; n is tiny early
notes: Require at least three buys.

name: buySizeCv
definition: Standard deviation of buy immediate quote divided by its mean.
rationale: Separates uniform scripted sizing from heterogeneous demand.
notes: Use a minimum sample and cap outliers.

name: buySizeP90P50
definition: 90th percentile buy quote divided by max(median buy quote, epsilon).
rationale: Detects a heavy upper tail without being dominated by total flow.
notes: Not meaningful below five buys.

name: maxBuyTradeShareBps
definition: Largest single buy immediate quote divided by cumulative gross buy quote, times 10,000.
rationale: Separates single-print dominance from cumulative wallet dominance.
notes: Useful diagnostic; entity concentration is more robust.

name: firstBuyerCumulativeShareBps
definition: All observed buy quote from the wallet that submitted the first buy, divided by total gross buy quote, times 10,000.
rationale: Captures continued first-actor control that V1 firstBuyerShareBps misses.
cache_requirements: first buyer key plus flow map
notes: Top-20 missing candidate.

name: top2BuyerShareBps
definition: Combined gross-buy quote share of the two largest buyer wallets, times 10,000.
rationale: Detects duopoly hidden by a modest top-one share.
notes: Entity-adjusted version has higher priority.

name: top5BuyerShareBps
definition: Combined gross-buy quote share of the five largest buyer wallets, times 10,000.
rationale: Measures broader wallet concentration.
notes: Emit missing/sample-count indicators rather than fill with 100%.

name: buyerFlowEntropyNorm
definition: Shannon entropy of wallet gross-buy shares divided by log(number of buyer wallets), with a defined singleton value of zero.
rationale: Captures the full distribution and is less top-one-specific than dominance.
notes: Do not interpret wallet entropy as independent-entity entropy.

name: buyerFlowGini
definition: Gini coefficient of cumulative gross-buy quote across buyer wallets.
rationale: Adds an inequality measure directly comparable with open-source token-risk work.
evidence_relation: Large-sample concentration-risk association at later horizons.
notes: Checkpoint-causal adaptation of a later-horizon literature feature.

name: medianBuyInterarrivalMs
definition: Median receive-time gap between consecutive buy events observed by decision.
rationale: Measures organic-looking arrival pace without extrapolating a count.
evidence_relation: Related to liquidity accumulation speed; exact gap statistic unvalidated.
notes: Record zero-gap share separately.

name: buyInterarrivalBurstiness
definition: (standard_deviation_gap - mean_gap)/(standard_deviation_gap + mean_gap) over consecutive buy receive gaps.
rationale: Distinguishes clustered bursts from steadier demand at equal count.
notes: Use only with feed-quality controls.

name: timeToSecondBuyMs
definition: Receive milliseconds from create to the second buy; missing if fewer than two buys by decision.
rationale: A direct early liquidity-accumulation timing statistic.
evidence_relation: Strong related evidence that faster state acquisition matters.
selection_bias_risk: high if conditioned on reaching two buys
notes: Never backfill into earlier checkpoints.

name: timeToFifthBuyMs
definition: Receive milliseconds from create to the fifth buy; missing until the fifth buy is observed.
rationale: Captures multi-print impulse speed.
leakage_risk: low if as-of missingness is preserved
selection_bias_risk: high if only completed paths retained
notes: Model jointly with number of unique buyers.

name: timeToGrossBuy0_5SolMs
definition: Milliseconds from create until cumulative V1-exact gross buy first reaches 0.5 SOL; missing before crossing.
rationale: Measures economically weighted impulse speed at a fixed quote state.
evidence_relation: Closest causal adaptation of trades/time-to-fixed-liquidity evidence.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; threshold must be predeclared, not fitted on holdout.

name: buysToGrossBuy0_5Sol
definition: Number of buy events required to first reach 0.5 SOL cumulative exact gross buy; missing before crossing.
rationale: Tests whether liquidity came from few large prints or broader activity.
evidence_relation: Direct adaptation of the paper's trades-to-fixed-vSOL result.
notes: Interpret with unique/entity count; fewer trades was favorable for graduation in Marino et al., so do not assume lower concentration is always better.

name: reserveMovePerBuy
definition: earlyReserveMovementPct / max(buyCount,1).
rationale: Curve progress efficiency per print.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; retain count and raw move too.

name: reserveMovePerMs
definition: earlyReserveMovementPct divided by max(mintAgeMs,1).
rationale: Continuous curve-progress velocity independent of fixed-window count transforms.
notes: Condition on checkpoint rather than mixing ages.

name: grossBuySolPerUniqueBuyer
definition: grossBuySol / max(uniqueBuyers,1).
rationale: Economically weights participation concentration.
notes: Entity-adjusted denominator preferred.

name: signedTradeCountImbalance
definition: (buyCount-sellCount)/max(buyCount+sellCount,1).
rationale: Scale-free direction by event count.
notes: Mostly saturated before any sell; value imbalance is stronger.

name: signedTradeValueImbalance
definition: (grossBuySol-grossSellSol)/max(grossBuySol+grossSellSol,epsilon).
rationale: Scale-free economically weighted direction.
notes: Retain raw numerator and denominator.

name: firstSellLatencyMs
definition: First sell receive_ms minus create receive_ms; missing until a sell is observed.
rationale: Early exits can reveal creator/sniper recycling or fragile demand.
evidence_relation: Creator/early-sell behavior has empirical risk relevance.
leakage_risk: high if later sell time is backfilled into earlier rows
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; include censoring/availability indicator.

name: buyerSellerOverlapShare
definition: Fraction of distinct sellers that also appeared as buyers of the mint before their first observed sell.
rationale: Detects rapid round-trip churn rather than exogenous holders.
evidence_relation: Wash/churn association; legitimate scalping also contributes.
cache_requirements: per-mint buyer set and seller set
data_quality_risk: off-program token transfers hide ownership linkage
notes: Not a wash-trade proof.

name: roundTripQuoteShare
definition: Sell quote from wallets that previously bought, divided by cumulative gross buy quote.
rationale: Quantifies economically meaningful early recycling.
cache_requirements: wallet buy-seen set plus sell accumulator
data_quality_risk: wallet transfers outside Pump are unobserved
notes: Use with creator-linked and entity-linked variants.

name: maxOrderSignRun
definition: Longest consecutive run of buy or sell event signs in receive order, with the sign of the maximum run encoded separately.
rationale: Differentiates a clean impulse from alternating churn.
notes: Avoid collapsing direction and run length into one scalar.

name: curveImpactPerGrossSol
definition: earlyReserveMovementPct / max(grossBuySol+grossSellSol,epsilon), with direction-aware variants.
rationale: Detects inconsistent decode and characterizes nonlinear state response per transacted quote.
evidence_relation: Platform mechanism; likely more useful as quality/control than alpha.
data_quality_risk: fees make gross cash flow differ from reserve input
notes: Define reserve-input variant separately when using canonical invariant math.

name: curveCompletionPct
definition: Causal fraction of bonding-curve token inventory sold or equivalent canonical progress computed from current real/virtual reserve fields.
rationale: Normalizes launches to curve lifecycle state and supports fixed-state path comparisons.
evidence_relation: Direct platform mechanism with strong state-path evidence.
cache_requirements: canonical initial/config constants by program version
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; prefer canonical reserve-state math over an RPC supply proxy.

name: currentHolderHhi
definition: HHI of estimated current token inventory across observed wallets using causal buy token_amount minus causal sell token_amount.
rationale: Current ownership can diverge sharply from buy-flow concentration after exits.
evidence_relation: Large-sample concentration-risk association; early causal adaptation required.
spoofability: high via sybil wallets and unobserved transfers
data_quality_risk: SPL transfers outside captured Pump transactions make inventory incomplete
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; call it estimated Pump-trade inventory unless all token transfers are collected.

name: top5CurrentHolderShare
definition: Combined share of estimated current Pump-trade-derived token inventory held by the five largest wallets.
rationale: Directly adapts open-source top-k holder features to causal checkpoints.
evidence_relation: Strong risk association at later horizons.
notes: Entity-adjusted version is preferable.

name: earlyBuyerRetentionRatio
definition: Current estimated token inventory of the first K buyers divided by their cumulative acquired token amount, evaluated causally at decision.
rationale: Detects early-buyer dumping and retained insider inventory.
evidence_relation: Open-source later-horizon feature with strong manipulation relevance.
notes: Use multiple preregistered K values sparingly; literature used later/migration-time horizons.

name: createAndBuySameTransaction
definition: Indicator that the canonical create instruction and at least one buy instruction for the mint occur in the same Solana transaction.
rationale: Separates atomic launch seeding from later organic arrival.
evidence_relation: Officially supported construction plus practitioner risk hypothesis; not inherently malicious.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; same transaction is distinct from same slot.

name: creatorUserBuyerRolePattern
definition: Categorical equality pattern among create.creator, create transaction payer/user, and first buy user.
rationale: Makes creator-funded, delegated, and third-party launch paths explicit.
evidence_relation: Direct role mechanics; predictive interpretation must be learned prospectively.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; encode categories rather than a single suspicious flag.

name: launchSignerCount
definition: Number of required signer accounts in the create transaction message.
rationale: Multi-signer launch structure can reveal coordination tooling or custody patterns.
notes: Legitimate relayers can also add signers.

name: launchInstructionCount
definition: Count of outer plus inner instructions in the create transaction, with outer and inner counts retained separately.
rationale: Characterizes route complexity and bundled actions.
notes: Prefer categorical route fingerprint to a raw count alone.

name: launchMaxCpiDepth
definition: Maximum invocation stack depth among launch transaction instructions/logs.
rationale: Distinguishes direct program access from router/front-end/CPI paths.
evidence_relation: Route/bot proxy with related empirical evidence.
data_quality_risk: stack height absent on some encodings
notes: Do not label all direct calls bots without calibration.

name: directPumpInvocationShare
definition: Share of observed buy transactions where Pump is invoked directly at the outer instruction layer rather than through a known frontend/router/CPI path.
rationale: Operationalizes a time-consistent bot-like access proxy used in recent Pump research.
evidence_relation: Large-sample association with graduation; direct invocation is only a proxy for automation.
selection_bias_risk: high if taxonomy reflects one frontend era
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; report as direct-contract share, not bot probability.

name: routeFingerprintId
definition: Stable categorical hash/taxonomy of ordered program IDs, instruction kinds, CPI shape, and selected non-user account roles for each transaction.
rationale: Allows recurring execution software/cohort patterns without brittle single-program rules.
leakage_risk: medium if dictionary learned using future labels
notes: Freeze dictionary by training epoch and include UNKNOWN.

name: computeUnitLimit
definition: Compute-unit limit requested by Compute Budget instructions in the transaction, or protocol default with an explicit missing/default flag.
rationale: Execution software and urgency fingerprint; needed to interpret priority price.
evidence_relation: Direct execution mechanism; alpha relationship is associative.
notes: Treat as execution/route context, not standalone token alpha.

name: computeUnitPriceMicroLamports
definition: Micro-lamports per compute unit requested by the transaction's Compute Budget instruction.
rationale: Measures priority-fee urgency independent of CU limit.
evidence_relation: Direct scheduler incentive; token-alpha sign is ambiguous.
notes: Normalize against causal network fee percentiles.

name: priorityFeeLamports
definition: Requested compute-unit limit multiplied by compute-unit price divided by one million, with actual charged fee retained when available.
rationale: Economic urgency and transaction inclusion cost.
notes: Use percentile/z-score interaction with congestion.

name: computeUnitsConsumed
definition: Actual compute units consumed from transaction meta.
rationale: Separates complex routes from overprovisioned limits and supports tip/priority efficiency.
notes: Use mainly for route normalization and anomaly detection.

name: jitoTipLamports
definition: Lamports transferred to a currently valid Jito tip account in the transaction; zero and unavailable are distinct.
rationale: On-chain evidence of block-engine bidding and execution urgency.
evidence_relation: Direct execution mechanism; not proof of a bundle or alpha.
spoofability: medium and costly; can transfer to tip account without bundle
data_quality_risk: tip-account list freshness and inner transfers
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; indicator is on-chain, but bundle identity is not inferable from tip alone.

name: jitoTipPerComputeUnit
definition: Jito tip lamports divided by actual or requested compute units, with explicit denominator source.
rationale: Matches the economic efficiency dimension used in Jito account-lock auctions more closely than raw tip.
evidence_relation: Direct auction mechanism; token-alpha relation unknown.
notes: Normalize by the current causal tip market.

name: usesAddressLookupTable
definition: Indicator/count of loaded address-table accounts in the versioned transaction.
rationale: A stable transaction-construction fingerprint for sophisticated clients/routes.
notes: Likely route-identification value rather than directional alpha.

name: accountLockFootprint
definition: Counts of writable and readonly accounts in the transaction message after address-table expansion.
rationale: Approximates account-lock complexity and auction competition class.
evidence_relation: Direct scheduling/auction mechanism; alpha link associative.
notes: Could help explain failures and latency.

name: sameTransactionMultiBuyerCount
definition: Number of distinct buyer/user identities or attributed buyer instruction groups for the mint within one transaction.
rationale: Detects atomic coordination that wallet-level event counts can disguise.
required_raw_data: all mint trade instructions/events grouped by signature
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; do not infer common ownership solely from co-transaction presence.

name: successfulAttemptRatio
definition: Successful attributed Pump transactions divided by successful plus failed attributed attempts for the mint within a trailing window.
rationale: Normalizes V1 failedTransactionCount by observed opportunity and network conditions.
required_raw_data: successful and failed attributed transaction arrivals
notes: Include global failure baseline.

name: firstBuyTransactionIndexDelta
definition: First-buy transaction index minus create transaction index when both are in the same finalized slot; missing otherwise.
rationale: Orders same-slot activity more precisely than receive time or sameSlotBuyCount.
required_raw_data: transaction_index for create and first buy
leakage_risk: high if finalized transaction index arrives after the decision and is backfilled
data_quality_risk: real-time index availability versus finalized reconstruction
notes: Use only when the index itself was known by the checkpoint; otherwise research-only.

name: buyConstraintAggressivenessBps
definition: Distance between the buyer's maximum SOL cost/minimum token output constraint and the canonical local quote at instruction observation, expressed in bps.
rationale: Measures urgency/slippage tolerance and bot configuration beyond realized fill size.
evidence_relation: Direct instruction intent; alpha relationship unvalidated.
required_raw_data: decoded buy arguments including max cost/min output
notes: Keep exact-quote-in and max-cost variants separate.

name: bundleIdAndTransactionCount
definition: Side-channel-provided Jito bundle identifier and number/order of bundle transactions containing launch-related activity.
rationale: True bundle membership is stronger coordination evidence than an on-chain tip or same-slot coincidence.
evidence_relation: Direct atomic-coordination mechanism; outcome association needs prospective testing.
required_raw_data: prospective block-engine/bundle telemetry keyed by signature
spoofability: low for observed bundle membership; non-Jito private paths remain missing
leakage_risk: high if bundle data arrives after checkpoint and is backfilled
selection_bias_risk: high to one block engine/leader set
notes: Top-10 prospective raw addition; do not infer this field from tips.

name: buyerPriorPumpMintCount
definition: For each early buyer, number of distinct Pump mints traded before decision; aggregate as weighted mean, max, and zero-history share.
rationale: Separates fresh wallets from experienced Pump participants.
evidence_relation: Ex-ante trader history has large-sample predictive association.
cache_requirements: as-of wallet distinct-mint counters; never rebuild without timestamp versioning
leakage_risk: critical if later activity enters history
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; a rich extension of V1's binary recurrence.

name: buyerPriorPumpTradeCount
definition: Causally frozen prior Pump buy/sell event count per early buyer, aggregated by quote-weighted mean and percentiles.
rationale: Frequency distinguishes one prior appearance from sustained specialization.
required_raw_data: historical Pump events by user before decision
notes: Winsorize extreme bot counts.

name: buyerPriorActivityRecencyMs
definition: Elapsed time from decision to each buyer's last prior Pump event, summarized by minimum and quote-weighted median.
rationale: Recent cross-launch activity can identify active sniper cohorts and current expertise.
cache_requirements: last prior timestamp per wallet with strict event ordering
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; separate ultra-recent co-fire from general history.

name: buyerPriorEarlyEntryRate
definition: Fraction of a buyer's prior Pump mints where the wallet entered within a preregistered causal age/state threshold, computed only from launches preceding decision.
rationale: Identifies systematic early-entry behavior without using current-token outcomes.
required_raw_data: historical create and buyer first-entry times
leakage_risk: high if thresholds selected on holdout
notes: Preregister threshold family to avoid search sprawl.

name: buyerPriorGraduationRateShrunk
definition: Bayesian-shrunk fraction of causally completed prior tokens bought by each wallet that later graduated, using only outcomes known before decision; aggregate across current buyers.
rationale: Operationalizes ex-ante successful-trader presence with variance control.
evidence_relation: Large-sample Pump-specific predictive association, described as modest/double-edged.
cache_requirements: event-time wallet performance cache with shrinkage and sample count
leakage_risk: critical; only graduations already observed before current decision
selection_bias_risk: high from immature prior tokens and coverage
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; never use eventual outcomes of still-open prior tokens.

name: buyerPriorRealizedPnlShrunk
definition: Robust/shrunk realized Pump trading PnL for each buyer from fully observed prior closed positions only, aggregated quote-weighted.
rationale: Separates repeat losers, extractors, and plausibly skilled early participants.
evidence_relation: Ex-ante skill/behavior association; exact accounting is difficult.
compute_cost: O(buyers) lookups after heavy offline update
data_quality_risk: SPL transfers and partial inventory histories
notes: Use realized-only plus sample size; prefer rank buckets over false precision.

name: buyerPriorMedianHoldMs
definition: Median duration of causally completed prior Pump positions for each current buyer, summarized across buyers.
rationale: Differentiates immediate flippers from longer-horizon participants.
leakage_risk: critical if current/open positions included with future closes
notes: Keep censored/open prior positions out of the median and expose sample count.

name: knownSniperCohortShareBps
definition: Gross buy share attributable to a causally frozen set of recurrent ultra-early Pump wallets or cohorts, with cohort definition trained only before decision epoch.
rationale: Measures whether familiar launch-specialist actors control the impulse.
evidence_relation: Behavioral/cohort association; sign can be positive skill or toxic extraction.
leakage_risk: critical if cohort learned across test period
notes: Do not give the cohort a fixed positive sign; learn/review by cohort.

name: earlyBuyerCofireSimilarity
definition: Maximum and mean historical Jaccard/cosine co-occurrence of current early buyers across launches strictly before decision.
rationale: Detects coordinated groups even when no direct funding edge is visible.
compute_cost: O(buyer pairs) bounded early; approximate lookup preferred
leakage_risk: critical if graph includes future launches
data_quality_risk: common popular launches create spurious similarity
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; inverse-frequency weight common launches.

name: entityAdjustedUniqueBuyers
definition: Number of inferred beneficial-entity clusters among early buyer wallets using only graph evidence available before decision plus same-transaction evidence available now.
rationale: Corrects wallet counts for sybil splitting, a central limitation of V1 concentration features.
evidence_relation: Strong concentration-risk evidence after entity grouping; clustering itself is probabilistic.
leakage_risk: critical if future graph edges included
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; retain raw wallet count and confidence/coverage.

name: entityAdjustedBuyerHhi
definition: HHI after aggregating gross-buy quote across probabilistic or deterministic wallet-entity clusters.
rationale: Directly addresses split-wallet evasion of buyerHhi.
evidence_relation: Large empirical concentration increase for risky tokens after grouping.
leakage_risk: critical if graph is not as-of
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; one of the five highest-value families.

name: commonFunderBuyShareBps
definition: Gross-buy share of early buyers linked to the same direct or bounded-hop SOL funder before launch, weighted by edge confidence.
rationale: Detects hub-and-spoke sniper funding obscured by wallet-level diversity.
evidence_relation: Practitioner plus broader forensic association; exact early-alpha effect unvalidated.
cache_requirements: rolling prelaunch SOL funding graph and bounded-hop index
notes: Top-20 missing candidate and top-10 raw addition; current Pump-only ledger is insufficient for general funding provenance.

name: creatorLinkedBuyShareBps
definition: Gross-buy share of wallets linked before launch to creator, create payer, or known creator entity by direct funding, bounded-hop funding, ownership, or strong causal co-fire evidence.
rationale: Measures insider participation that ordinary buyer concentration misses.
evidence_relation: Strong manipulation mechanism; graph attribution is uncertain.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; retain link-type and confidence breakdowns.

name: buyerWalletAgeMs
definition: Decision time minus each buyer wallet's first observed on-chain activity time, summarized and quote-weighted.
rationale: Fresh burner concentration can signal coordinated launches.
selection_bias_risk: high if collector start is mistaken for wallet birth
notes: An observed-lower-bound age must not be labeled true chain age.

name: buyerFundingAgeMs
definition: Elapsed time from each buyer's last material inbound SOL funding event before launch to decision, summarized and quote-weighted.
rationale: Just-in-time funding is a stronger coordination signal than wallet age alone.
notes: Predeclare materiality threshold in SOL and normalize by SOL price only outside immediate path.

name: buyerFundingFanout
definition: Number of other early-participant wallets funded by the same prelaunch source within a causal lookback window.
rationale: Quantifies hub-and-spoke distribution.
notes: Downweight known exchange/service funders.

name: freshBurnerBuyShareBps
definition: Gross-buy share from wallets satisfying preregistered low-age, low-prior-activity, and recent-funding conditions.
rationale: Combines weak provenance signals into a falsifiable burner exposure metric.
leakage_risk: high if rule thresholds searched broadly
notes: Report component coverage; do not hard-veto without prospective evidence.

name: exchangeFundedBuyShareBps
definition: Gross-buy share from wallets whose most recent material prelaunch funding source is a causally known exchange/service cluster.
rationale: Separates shared-service funding from creator-controlled common-funder graphs and may indicate retail arrival.
leakage_risk: medium if labels updated from future evidence
notes: Useful mainly to reduce common-funder false positives.

name: buyerQualityWeightedFlow
definition: Sum of current buy quote weighted by a preregistered, causally frozen buyer-quality score built only from completed prior behavior, divided by gross buy quote.
rationale: Combines flow strength with who supplied it.
evidence_relation: Direct extension of ex-ante successful-trader evidence.
cache_requirements: calibrated timestamped wallet-quality score with UNKNOWN
leakage_risk: critical; nested model must be cross-fitted and as-of
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; preserve score sample size and unknown-flow share.

name: walletHistoryCoverageShareBps
definition: Gross-buy share for which required wallet-history/provenance cache fields are available and old enough to be trustworthy.
rationale: Prevents missing graph coverage from masquerading as clean or novel participation.
selection_bias_risk: critical if uncovered wallets are imputed as benign
notes: Required companion to every history/graph feature family.

name: creatorPriorLaunchCount
definition: Number of Pump creates attributable to the creator identity strictly before the current create, with raw-wallet and entity-adjusted versions.
rationale: Separates one-off creators from serial launchers.
evidence_relation: Large-sample evidence says prolific creators are not broadly favorable; small top-creator effects were only suggestive.
cache_requirements: as-of creator launch counter and optional entity map
leakage_risk: critical if current/future launches included incorrectly
notes: Do not assign a monotone positive sign.

name: creatorPriorLaunchRecencyMs
definition: Current create time minus creator's immediately prior Pump create time.
rationale: Burst launching can indicate campaign tooling or extraction cycles.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate as part of creator history.

name: creatorLaunchCadenceRegularity
definition: Robust dispersion/periodicity of intervals among the creator's prior launches, requiring a minimum sample.
rationale: Highly regular cadence can fingerprint automation.
leakage_risk: medium if cadence windows selected post hoc
notes: Expose count; undefined for sparse history.

name: creatorPriorGraduationRateShrunk
definition: Bayesian-shrunk fraction of the creator's prior launches whose graduation occurred before current create time.
rationale: Tests creator track record without future leakage.
evidence_relation: Pump-specific evidence found limited broad value, so treat as conditional/contextual.
notes: A null/negative result is plausible; do not promote on narrative appeal.

name: creatorPriorNoImpulseRate
definition: Fraction of prior creator launches that failed to receive a buy within a preregistered causal horizon, using only fully matured historical windows before current create.
rationale: Measures repeated low-demand launch behavior without waiting for full market outcomes.
cache_requirements: creator matured-launch counters by fixed horizon
leakage_risk: high if not-yet-mature launches enter denominator
notes: Potentially more causally available than creator PnL.

name: creatorPriorDumpLatencyMedian
definition: Median time from create to first creator/entity-linked sell on completed prior launches, frozen before current create.
rationale: Serial fast dumping is directly relevant to runner/scalp hazard.
evidence_relation: Creator sell dynamics have direct Pump-specific risk relevance.
cache_requirements: creator/entity sell-latency summaries with censoring counts
leakage_risk: critical if future sells/current launch used
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; include no-sell/censored fraction.

name: creatorPriorExtractionRatio
definition: Fee-aware realized SOL extracted by creator/entity-linked wallets from completed prior launches divided by their invested SOL, robustly summarized and strictly as-of.
rationale: Directly profiles value-extraction behavior.
evidence_relation: Forensic association; accounting uncertainty is substantial.
notes: Use coarse bins and coverage, not false precision.

name: creatorCurrentBuyShareBps
definition: Current gross-buy quote share directly from creator, create payer, or prelaunch creator-linked entities, with link types separated.
rationale: Measures current insider seeding.
evidence_relation: Direct insider-concentration mechanism; sign depends on retention and distribution.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate.

name: creatorCurrentSellShareBps
definition: Gross sell quote share attributable to creator/payer/entity-linked wallets observed by decision.
rationale: Separates general sell pressure from insider exits.
leakage_risk: critical if entity map uses future edges
notes: No future sells may be backfilled.

name: creatorRetainedInventoryShare
definition: Estimated current token inventory share held by creator/payer/entity-linked wallets from causal buys, sells, and captured transfers.
rationale: Distinguishes committed retained inventory from rapid distribution.
notes: Label estimate scope explicitly.

name: creatorRecurringEarlyBuyerShare
definition: Current gross-buy share from wallets that appeared early on this creator's prior launches, strictly before current create.
rationale: Detects reusable distribution/sniper rings around a creator.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate.

name: creatorWalletObservedAgeMs
definition: Create time minus first globally observed activity of the creator wallet, explicitly a lower bound when archive coverage is incomplete.
rationale: Fresh creator identities may signal disposable launch infrastructure.
notes: Never substitute collector first-seen without a coverage-start flag.

name: creatorFundingSourceClass
definition: Versioned class and confidence of the creator's latest material prelaunch funder: exchange/service, recurrent deployer, peer, unknown, or linked buyer hub.
rationale: Adds funding provenance and helps interpret buyer common-funder graphs.
notes: Top-10 prospective raw addition family.

name: creatorFeeRecipientTopology
definition: Categorical topology of creator, creator-fee recipient/shareholders, payer, and linked entities from canonical event/config fields.
rationale: Revenue-sharing relationships can expose repeated teams or beneficiary concentration.
evidence_relation: Direct platform economics; alpha relationship unvalidated.
leakage_risk: low for current fields; high for entity links
notes: Raw decoded trade events already expose fee recipient/shareholders, but V1 does not feature them.

name: creatorHistoryCoverage
definition: Availability, observation-start age, sample count, and entity-link confidence for creator history features.
rationale: Unknown creator history must not be treated as clean history.
selection_bias_risk: critical if missing mapped to zero risk
notes: Mandatory companion for creator features.

name: onchainNameShape
definition: Predeclared lexical vector from the create name: byte/character length, case pattern, digit share, punctuation share, whitespace normalization, script family, and emoji count.
rationale: Cheaply fingerprints templated campaigns and malformed/attention-seeking naming.
evidence_relation: Indirect naming-risk association; no direct early-alpha proof.
compute_cost: O(name length), bounded by protocol limit
notes: Raw create args are available; use a frozen tokenizer.

name: onchainSymbolShape
definition: Predeclared lexical vector from symbol: length, character classes, repeated characters, digit share, and name-symbol edit/substring similarity.
rationale: Detects templates, confusing symbols, and branding inconsistency.
notes: Do not search thousands of ad hoc substrings.

name: metadataUriShape
definition: URI scheme, host, path depth, query presence, length, CID/provider type, and parse-valid indicator from create.uri.
rationale: Identifies reusable hosting/tooling and malformed metadata without remote access.
evidence_relation: Direct observable with indirect predictive evidence.
cache_requirements: local URI parser and host taxonomy
notes: Safe for hot path because it performs no network call.

name: metadataUriReuseCountPrior
definition: Number of prior creates using the exact normalized URI/CID/host-path fingerprint before current create.
rationale: Detects recycled campaign assets and launch factories.
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; exact/CID reuse is stronger than host reuse.

name: brandImpersonationSimilarity
definition: Maximum normalized string/confusable similarity of name and symbol to a versioned local cache of established tokens, brands, and currently trending entities.
rationale: Captures impersonation and topical-copying risk noted in forensic research.
evidence_relation: Risk association; trendy similarity may also be demand-positive.
cache_requirements: timestamped local brand/trend trie and confusable map
leakage_risk: high if vocabulary contains future trends
notes: Separate stable-brand impersonation risk from trend similarity.

name: metadataFetchStatusLatency
definition: As-of status, HTTP class, content type/size, and elapsed time for an asynchronous fetch of create.uri, with observed_at attached.
rationale: Makes off-chain availability and missingness causal and auditable.
required_raw_data: prospective async metadata fetch response and timestamps
leakage_risk: critical if later successful fetch backfills earlier decision
notes: Top-10 prospective raw addition; use only in a later model/head.

name: metadataContentSchema
definition: Presence/length/type vector for description, image, animation/video, website, X, Telegram, and other declared links in the fetched JSON as known by decision.
rationale: Adds richer launch presentation context found in public datasets.
evidence_relation: Incremental association; social-link presence alone is weak and manipulable.
selection_bias_risk: high from fetch success and graduated-only literature
notes: Absence and fetch failure must be different states.

name: descriptionEmbedding
definition: Frozen-model vector or preregistered low-dimensional projection of metadata description text observed by decision.
rationale: Text adds modest incremental signal when combined with temporal features in SOLMEMES.
evidence_relation: Peer-reviewed incremental association, but only on graduated tokens and later ROI.
cache_requirements: local model and content-hash embedding cache
compute_cost: few-ms local inference after network fetch
leakage_risk: high if model/vocabulary trained on future corpus
selection_bias_risk: critical due to graduated-only source dataset
notes: Not an immediate-entry feature; temporal-only baseline must be reported.

name: metadataContentReuseSimilarity
definition: Maximum prior-only similarity of description embedding, image perceptual hash, and content hash to earlier launches, with creator-linked and global versions.
rationale: Detects recycled launch factories beyond exact URI reuse.
cache_requirements: as-of ANN index and perceptual-hash index
compute_cost: image decode plus ANN lookup; asynchronous
leakage_risk: critical if index includes later launches
notes: Top-10 prospective raw addition; store raw bytes/hash and observed time.

name: narrativeTrendSimilarity
definition: Similarity of on-chain name/symbol and available description/image embedding to trend centroids frozen immediately before launch.
rationale: Tests whether a launch aligns with current attention rather than stale templates.
evidence_relation: Association; causality and manipulation are unresolved.
cache_requirements: versioned trend cache sourced outside the hot path
leakage_risk: critical if trends are computed after launch
notes: Use name/symbol-only immediate variant and richer late variant separately.

name: websiteDomainAgeAndHealth
definition: As-of domain registration age where legally/technically available, DNS/HTTPS reachability, redirect chain, and domain reuse for the declared website.
rationale: Disposable infrastructure may increase risk.
evidence_relation: Forensic association; coverage and privacy are poor.
leakage_risk: critical if current domain state substitutes launch-time state
notes: Never block the local buy hot path.

name: socialAccountAsOfProfile
definition: Launch-time snapshot of declared X/Telegram account existence, age, followers, activity, and reciprocal token/site linkage.
rationale: Potential trust/attention context but extremely manipulable.
evidence_relation: Association only; social metrics can be bought and later edited.
notes: Research-only late context; no immediate model dependency.

name: pumpCommentActivityAsOf
definition: Count, unique authors, pace, and text duplication of platform comments observed by decision, if a causally timestamped feed is collected.
rationale: Platform-native attention may complement trade activity.
required_raw_data: prospective Pump comment events and observation times
compute_cost: local rolling aggregates after external collection
notes: Do not add an HTTP/API call to the hot path.

name: metadataMutationAfterCreate
definition: Indicator and content-hash delta when the same URI returns different content across causally timestamped observations.
rationale: Mutable bait-and-switch metadata is a risk signal.
leakage_risk: critical for immediate entry because mutation occurs later
notes: Valid retrospective/monitoring risk feature, unavailable for immediate launch entry.

name: globalGrossBuySol1sPrior
definition: V1-exact gross buy quote across all observed Pump mints in [d-1s,d), excluding the current event at d.
rationale: Distinguishes token-local demand from a platform-wide buying burst.
required_raw_data: global Pump buy exact quote and arrival time
notes: Value-weighted complement to raw trade count.

name: globalNetBuySol1sPrior
definition: Global exact gross buy quote minus exact gross sell quote in [d-1s,d).
rationale: Captures immediate platform risk-on/risk-off flow.
notes: Also compute 5 s and 60 s preregistered scales.

name: globalUniqueActiveWallets1sPrior
definition: Distinct Pump trade users observed in [d-1s,d).
rationale: Separates broad market participation from a few high-frequency bots.
required_raw_data: global Pump trade users and arrival times
notes: Entity-adjustment is optional and slower.

name: globalActiveMintCount1sPrior
definition: Distinct Pump mints with a trade in [d-1s,d).
rationale: Measures how fragmented attention is across competing curves.
required_raw_data: global trade mint and arrival time
notes: Use alongside launch count as attention competition.

name: recentLaunchFirstImpulseRate
definition: Among launches old enough to mature a fixed prior-only horizon, fraction receiving a first buy within that horizon.
rationale: A causal platform demand/bot-health indicator more meaningful than raw launch count.
notes: Lag the statistic by its maturity horizon.

name: tokenFlowCrossSectionalPercentile
definition: Percentile of token gross/net flow or unique-buyer growth relative to launches at the same checkpoint in a strictly prior rolling window.
rationale: Normalizes for changing activity and fee regimes.
evidence_relation: State/flow association with causal regime normalization.
cache_requirements: checkpoint-specific streaming quantile sketches frozen before current row
leakage_risk: critical if current/future cohort enters reference distribution
selection_bias_risk: high because V1 omits zero-trade rows
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; reference population must include all causally eligible launches, including zero-flow rows.

name: tokenCurveEfficiencyPercentile
definition: Prior-window percentile of reserveMovePerBuy or time/trades-to-fixed-state at the same checkpoint.
rationale: Makes liquidity efficiency comparable across market regimes.
evidence_relation: Direct adaptation of strongest reported Pump state-path evidence.
leakage_risk: critical if reference window is not strictly prior
notes: Top-20 missing candidate.

name: recentGraduationRatePriorOnly
definition: Fraction of launches in a historical cohort whose graduation events were already observed before decision, with explicit lag and censoring.
rationale: Conditions opportunity on recent platform conversion quality.
evidence_relation: Regime association; graduation is not scalp profitability.
leakage_risk: critical because eventual graduations cannot be backfilled
notes: Keep separate from short-horizon scalp labels.

name: globalPumpFailureRate1sPrior
definition: Attributed failed Pump transactions divided by all observed Pump attempts in [d-1s,d), excluding the current event.
rationale: Distinguishes token-specific failures from congestion or bot storms.
required_raw_data: global successful/failed Pump transactions and arrival times
selection_bias_risk: high because successful trades and failed attempts have different attribution coverage
notes: Mandatory normalizer for mint-level failure features.

name: priorityFeePercentilePrior
definition: Current transaction priority fee or CU price percentile against successfully observed comparable transactions strictly before it in a short rolling window.
rationale: Measures relative urgency under changing congestion.
evidence_relation: Direct fee mechanism and execution context.
cache_requirements: streaming fee quantile sketch by transaction class
leakage_risk: low if current observation excluded from prior sketch
selection_bias_risk: high if only Pump successes sampled
notes: Use Pump-local and network-wide variants if full feed is collected.

name: jitoTipPercentilePrior
definition: Current detected Jito tip percentile against causal recent tips for comparable account-lock auctions or Pump transactions.
rationale: Normalizes raw tip for the current auction market.
cache_requirements: rolling tip quantile sketch and tip-account set
notes: Raw transaction data can support on-chain tips; full auction context needs new telemetry.

name: slotPhaseAtCreate
definition: Estimated elapsed milliseconds or normalized phase within the current slot when create was first received, with uncertainty.
rationale: Slot boundary affects observation/inclusion latency and same-slot opportunity.
data_quality_risk: slot duration variable and boundary estimate uncertain
notes: Top-10 raw addition only if existing slot updates are insufficiently retained; always expose uncertainty.

name: recentSlotDurationJitter
definition: Median and robust dispersion of completed slot durations strictly before the current slot.
rationale: Controls for network timing regimes that distort receive-window features.
leakage_risk: low when current incomplete slot excluded
notes: Essential if evaluating 25-100 ms features across providers.

name: jitoLeaderProximity
definition: Categorical current/next leader Jito affiliation and slots until next relevant leader, using schedule/identity information known before decision.
rationale: Jito auction/bundle behavior and propagation differ by leader path.
cache_requirements: locally refreshed leader schedule and identity map
notes: Top-10 prospective raw addition; execution context only.

name: writableAccountContentionPrior
definition: Recent causal count/fee intensity of transactions writing the same bonding-curve/global/config/tip account lock set.
rationale: Directly approximates local fee-market and Jito auction competition.
selection_bias_risk: high if feed sees only Pump successes
notes: Top-10 prospective raw addition; never query remote RPC in hot path.

name: solUsdReturnVolatilityPrior
definition: Strictly prior local-feed SOL/USD return and realized volatility over preregistered short windows, with source age.
rationale: Normalizes SOL-denominated flows and broad risk regime.
evidence_relation: External regime association; likely weak at subsecond launch horizon.
cache_requirements: local rolling price feed; no HTTP hot-path call
leakage_risk: high if bar closes after decision
notes: Top-10 prospective raw addition but secondary to Pump-local regime.

name: multiFeedArrivalDispersionMs
definition: Range/median absolute deviation of first-observation timestamps for the same signature/event across independent local feeds.
rationale: Quantifies whether apparent alpha is provider latency rather than chain behavior.
required_raw_data: prospective identical-event timestamps from at least two feeds
leakage_risk: high if a later feed timestamp is used at an earlier checkpoint
notes: Top-10 prospective raw addition; necessary for honest 25 ms claims. Official Jito docs now flag legacy ShredStream retirement, so transport version belongs in the raw record.

name: collectorHealthAsOf
definition: Causal vector of feed reconnect age, sequence gaps, decode-failure rate, clock offset estimate, queue depth, and writer lag at decision.
rationale: Fail-closed quality context prevents feed degradation from becoming spurious market signal.
selection_bias_risk: critical if unhealthy periods silently dropped
notes: Safety/validity feature, not alpha. Persist service/feed version because transport changes can shift distributions.

name: utcCyclicalTime
definition: Sin/cos encodings of UTC hour-of-day and day-of-week known at decision.
rationale: Allows smooth regime conditioning without brittle hour exclusions.
notes: Use as model context, not a hard dead-hour rule; current v4 evidence rejects the old skip-hour thesis.

name: featureDistributionDriftScore
definition: Distance between recent prior-only feature distributions and the frozen training reference, computed per checkpoint and data/feed version.
rationale: Detects strategy and collector drift before promotion.
cache_requirements: streaming distribution sketches keyed by version/checkpoint
compute_cost: periodic background computation plus O(1) lookup
selection_bias_risk: high if only traded/positive rows monitored
notes: Do not let this mutate V1 thresholds; it is a V2 research gate.

name: observedProtocolFeeBps
definition: Actual decoded protocol fee divided by the canonical fee base for each observed trade, aggregated with version/missing flags.
rationale: Separates flow changes from fee-regime changes and validates exact accounting.
notes: Primarily economics validation and regime context.

name: observedCreatorFeeBps
definition: Actual decoded creator fee divided by its canonical fee base, retaining recipient/shareholder topology.
rationale: Creator incentives and cash-flow semantics may vary across fee regimes.
evidence_relation: Direct platform economics; alpha relationship unknown.
notes: Do not alter V1 gross-quote semantics.

name: cashbackModeAndBps
definition: Decoded create/event cashback mode plus observed cashback bps/amount, with program-version context.
rationale: Cashback changes trader economics and V1 gross-buy composition.
notes: A required control if modes coexist.

name: quoteMintClass
definition: Canonical class of TradeEvent.quote_mint and quote-reserve fields, with SOL-quoted Pump exact-alpha eligibility as an explicit value.
rationale: Prevents incompatible quote economics from being pooled.
notes: Keep non-SOL quote modes outside the exact SOL-curve population unless explicitly researched as a sibling.

name: programAndSchemaVersion
definition: Pump program ID, instruction/event discriminator version, ledger schema version, and feature-code version known at decision.
rationale: Prevents silent protocol/decoder changes from appearing as alpha.
selection_bias_risk: critical if incompatible versions are silently excluded
notes: Mandatory registry key rather than predictive numeric input by default.

name: trackVolumeMode
definition: Decoded TradeEvent.track_volume boolean or equivalent canonical mode as observed by decision.
rationale: Version/mode context may change event/accounting behavior.
notes: Retain for stratification before testing as alpha.

name: nonTradeTokenTransferShare
definition: Share of token units moved through SPL transfers not explained by canonical Pump buy/sell settlement before decision, with sender/recipient relation classes.
rationale: Closes the largest gap in Pump-trade-derived holder inventory and can reveal hidden distribution.
required_raw_data: prospective mint-specific SPL transfer stream including non-Pump transactions
selection_bias_risk: high if subscriptions begin after create
notes: Top-10 prospective raw addition; must remain local and event-driven.

name: clusterAdjustedHolderHhiDelta
definition: Entity-adjusted current-holder HHI minus raw wallet-level current-holder HHI, with graph coverage/confidence.
rationale: Large positive deltas expose concentration hidden by wallet splitting.
evidence_relation: Strong empirical risk association after bundled/entity grouping.
leakage_risk: critical if entity graph uses future edges
notes: Top-20 missing candidate; one of the most important anti-sybil additions.

name: causalWashCycleScore
definition: Score from observed same-entity buy/sell round trips, alternating transfers, repeated sizes, short latencies, and near-flat entity inventory, using only events through decision.
rationale: Wallet counts and low concentration can be fabricated by wash patterns.
evidence_relation: Cross-market empirical risk association; exact early Pump calibration absent.
cache_requirements: local per-mint motif state and entity cache
leakage_risk: high if motifs completed after checkpoint are backfilled
notes: Risk feature, not definitive wash-trading label.

name: mayhemModeVeto
definition: Fail-closed indicator from canonical create/event mayhem_mode fields; Mayhem launches are excluded from the Pump exact-alpha population.
rationale: Preserves the stated safety boundary and avoids treating Mayhem as an alpha source.
notes: Never use Mayhem logic as alpha and never relax the veto on missing data.

name: canonicalProgramRouteVeto
definition: Indicator that create/trades use the expected canonical Pump program/version and SOL-quote curve route with recognized account layout.
rationale: Avoids applying Pump exact economics to lookalike programs or incompatible layouts.
notes: No Jupiter or remote fallback.

name: genericMintFreezeAuthorityRisk
definition: Generic SPL risk flag for mutable mint/freeze authorities.
rationale: Useful on arbitrary SPL launches but largely standardized or inapplicable inside the canonical Pump bonding-curve population.
evidence_relation: Generic token-risk mechanism, not discriminative exact-Pump alpha.
selection_bias_risk: critical if non-Pump evidence is imported uncritically
notes: Use only as route eligibility/sanity check, not a V2 exact-Pump alpha feature.

name: genericLpWithdrawalRisk
definition: Generic DEX feature measuring creator-controlled liquidity withdrawal or unlocked LP tokens.
rationale: Important on ordinary AMMs, but Pump bonding-curve liquidity and canonical graduation/migration mechanics differ materially.
evidence_relation: Generic rug mechanism not applicable to immediate canonical curve entry.
leakage_risk: critical because graduation/pool state is future at launch
notes: Do not import generic rug heuristics into exact Pump curve alpha.

name: futureRugOrPeakDrawdownLabelAsFeature
definition: Any eventual rug classification, future peak, future drawdown, future graduation, or later wallet/entity edge supplied to a launch-time feature row.
rationale: Explicitly registers the main leakage class so it cannot masquerade as feature engineering.
notes: May exist only in isolated label-generation pipelines, never in feature caches.

name: postGraduationPoolStateAtLaunch
definition: PumpSwap pool reserves, LP state, or post-migration liquidity observed after a token graduates and then attached to an earlier launch row.
rationale: Although canonical pool state is valuable later, it is unavailable at immediate launch entry.
evidence_relation: Future state, not causal launch alpha.
selection_bias_risk: critical because only graduates have it
notes: May support a separate post-graduation sibling strategy, not this exact-alpha objective.

name: futureSocialViralityAtLaunch
definition: Later follower growth, later comment volume, later search trend, or later engagement attached to the launch-time row.
rationale: Future attention is an outcome and creates severe leakage.
notes: Only launch-time timestamped snapshots are eligible, and even those are late/contextual.
